name: PlanetScale Migration
description: Migrate from Heroku Postgres to PlanetScale using Bucardo replication

PASSWORD.description: Password to access the migration dashboard

INDEX_REBUILD_WORKERS.description: Number of indexes to rebuild in parallel after the initial copy (default 8). Peak target parallelism is roughly this times PARALLEL_MAINTENANCE_WORKERS.

MAINTENANCE_WORK_MEM.description: maintenance_work_mem applied to each index build, e.g. 1GB (default 1GB). Allocated per concurrent build, so size relative to the target's memory.

DISABLE_INDEX_DEFERRAL.description: Set to 'true' to keep all indexes in place during the initial copy (disables the drop/rebuild speedup; default 'false'). When 'true', INDEX_REBUILD_WORKERS, MAINTENANCE_WORK_MEM, and PARALLEL_MAINTENANCE_WORKERS have no effect.
